verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Riskified serves an llms.txt at developers.riskified.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). That file states that appending .md to any documentation page URL returns its markdown version, and every cited doc page is in fact served as .md, so an agent can be pointed at the index and machine-readable pages directly. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
